thread:
deploy-bot: initiating staged rollout v2026.04.01-rc2 -> prod (wave=15%, regions=[us-east-1, us-west-2])

deploy-bot: rollout_id=rl-91ef, snapshot=sha256:ab12cd..., route=/api/generate (model=redwood-medium-13b)

sam: heads-up: automated smoke showed increased tail latency on us-east-1 nodes immediately after start (~p99 from 1.1s -> 2.4s).

tara: link?
sam: https://dash.redwood.prod/rl-91ef?filter=us-east-1 - p99 spike correlates with small uptick in connection errors to redis-client on worker pool.

peter (oncall): seeing increased connection resets from redis v6.2.8 client on 4/18 hosts in us-east-1; errors ~0.9% but p99 high. Our release playbook threshold for p99>2s OR errors>1% for 5m -> attenuate.
sre: agree with attenuate. Also recommend we pin routing to avoid cross-region spill while infra investigates.

prod-eng: are we confident it's client-side? any config diffs in this build?
sam: no app-config changes, but the model container image includes a small bump to redis client lib (rc-redis-2.3). Could be interaction with epoll handling.

tara: quickvote: attenuate to 5% in us-east-1 and pin rollout there.
prod-eng: vote :thumbsup: attenuate & pin
sam: vote :thumbsup: attenuate

peter: vote :thumbsup: attenuate (oncall)
sre: vote :thumbsdown: prefer to collect 2 more minutes (want trace samples)

deploy-bot: vote tally: 4 approve, 1 oppose -> executing traffic adjustment: us-east-1 15% -> 5% at 4939991300 (operator=peter)

deploy-bot: applied rule: {"rollout_id":"rl-91ef","region":"us-east-1","target_percent":5,"pin":true}

deploy-bot: pre/post snapshot (30s window):
```
pre: p50=140ms p95=420ms p99=2.4s errors=0.9%
post(30s): p50=130ms p95=210ms p99=980ms errors=0.35%
```

tara: attenuation helped, p99 dropped a lot. good immediate effect.

sre: request we also set a short-lived circuit-breaker on retried redis ops to avoid retry storms while infra debugs. can we patch route-level middleware?

prod-eng: we can toggle a routing flag to cap retries=1 for rl-91ef; infra ticket INF-777 created.

peter: applied retry cap=1 for rl-91ef at 4939991330. monitoring.

sam: traces show long blocking syscalls on the affected hosts during heavy KV eviction; infra to correlate with host kernel/userland.

infra: noted: a kernel micro-update was rolled to those hosts yesterday (kernel-5.15.x+patches). opening investigation INF-778; will try a soft-reboot on 1 host to see if it clears.

prod-eng: plan proposal: hold at 5% for 20m while infra investigates; if p99 <= 1.2s and errors <=0.5% -> resume to 30% over 15m. If p99 > 1.8s or errors >1% -> rollback to v2026.03.28 (stable).

peter: agreed. documenting on the runbook and adding change-window note: resuming ramp requires thumbs-up from infra + sres.

oncall: logging incident IN-4302 and paging infra and sres on rotation.

prod-eng: I'll add a quick note to internal release-notes: "v2026.04.01-rc2 temporarily attenuated in us-east-1 due to redis-client tail latency; mitigated with retry cap and region pin while infra investigates kernel interaction."

tara: follow-up: open ML/behavior ticket if any user-visible timeouts occur; downstream alerting for 504s should trigger.
sre: creating SRE follow-up SR-210 to track postmortem and root cause.

infra: soft-reboot on host i-0abc1234 succeeded; that host's p99 normalized. we'll try rolling soft-reboots on remaining affected hosts during low-traffic window (change window: 04:30-05:30 UTC).

sam: thanks. please also capture strace samples if possible before reboot for one host.

peter: consensus: attenuate -> pin -> apply retry cap -> investigate infra kernel -> hold 20m -> conditional resume/rollback. reopening thread when we reach decision. :mag_right:"
